Overview

Gjøvik is a city in Innlandet with a population of 30,000. A town on the western shore of Lake Mjøsa, known for its glassblowing tradition and winter sports. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
